notes: Context: SMB ecommerce SaaS, chat-based order support (customers can ask for order status, returns).
They signed up self-serve; primarily testing Hosted API on us-east-1. Low to moderate throughput (peak ~12 reqs/sec).
Primary ask: reliable streaming + function/tool calling so frontend can render live progress and then call backend order APIs with schema-validated args.

Problem described: when using streaming with function schema (JSON mode + tools), partial stream chunks sometimes leave the frontend with invalid JSON until final chunk — causes client-side JSON.parse failures and crashes UI.
Example from call: function schema expects {order_id: integer, action: string}, but model occasionally emits order_id as string or emits trailing comma in chunk N that only gets fixed in final chunk.
use_case_summary: Live chat for order support: streaming answers with tool-calls to backend order API. Need deterministic function schema enforcement so frontend can render intermediate progress without parsing errors.
tech_details: SDK: Node 0.9.2, using /v1/chat/stream with json mode enabled
Observed behaviour: partial function payloads emitted across multiple SSE/data chunks -> client concat logic failing; sometimes model returns order_id as '"12345"' instead of 12345
Workarounds tried: buffer until 'function_call' complete on client (adds latency), post-parse repair heuristics (fragile), toggling 'structured_output_prefer_json' flag (no change)
Logs: attached to INFR-4321; reproducer in drive:/Support/repros/foxfire-streaming-repro.md
